brief.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Create exactly ONE finished Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail, landscape 16:9, 1536x864 pixels or larger, opaque PNG.
Primary request: an energetic hand-drawn ink-and-brush illustration for バスケまとめ, matching the approved black #151A18 and electric lime #CCF43B visual system, warm off-white text, orange basketball, few strong elements, rough brush streaks and crisp heavy Japanese typography. Clearly illustrated, never photographic.

Real subject: Brandton Chatfield (ブラントン・チャットフィールド), the real basketball player. His official Tokyo Z profile was visually checked. Preserve these observed features: fair/light skin, short tousled curly light-brown hair with golden tips and short sides, fairly broad forehead, long oval face with a square strong jaw and chin, straight narrow nose, medium brown eyebrows, slightly deep-set eyes, clean-shaven face (NO beard or mustache), large athletic shoulders and muscular long arms. Do not substitute a generic imaginary athlete. He is selected randomly from the players named in the manuscript; no player name, jersey number, individual statistics, performance claim, or participation claim may appear in the image.

Composition: player on LEFT 43% of the frame, from upper thigh to above head, body twisting dynamically as he gathers an orange basketball securely with BOTH hands at upper chest level after an imagined rebound. The head is a clear three-quarter view, eyes focused slightly upward. Ball is a prop held by the player. Strong readable silhouette, anatomically plausible two arms and hands, five natural fingers per hand with realistic occlusion. Keep face, both hands, and entire ball well inside frame. Plain sleeveless off-white basketball kit with charcoal shading; no emblems, text, sponsors or numbers on clothing. No other people. This is a generic imagined basketball action, NOT a reenactment of any real game or decisive play. Abstract black background with broad lime diagonal ink sweeps behind athlete, restrained speckles; no arena signage or scoreboard.

Typography on RIGHT 54%, completely separate from face/hands/ball. Bold clean highly legible Japanese gothic headlines, carefully balanced and aligned, with safe margins. The following is the COMPLETE visible copy, spelled exactly, no extra copy:
small top: 「バスケまとめ」
largest headline: 「11/15 試合結果」
lime secondary headline: 「B.ONE 当日のEFF」
bold substantial line: 「ポジション別TOP3」
small but clearly readable two-line qualifiers: 「B.PREMIER：当日EFFは確定待ち」
「B.NEXT：この日試合なし」
small timestamp: 「2026.11.15 19:51時点」
footer: 「イラスト（AI生成）」 「イメージ」

The TOP3 applies separately to positions in B.ONE, not an overall ranking. Preserve the pending qualifier for B.PREMIER. Do not show scores or numeric player stats. Do not import the names, 38 points, dates, match scores, pose, or person from the older approved style example. No team logos, league logos, watermarks, official photographs, pasted photo cutouts, photorealism, collage, duplicated limbs, or clipped text. Render all lettering as part of the finished image.
